# Dakshina Ruchulu

> Highly-rated restaurant in Vijayawada, Andhra Pradesh — known for signature dum biryanis, coastal Andhra classics, and warm family dining. 4.4★ from 1,550+ Google reviews.

Dakshina Ruchulu serves authentic South Indian and Andhra cuisine in Labbipet, Vijayawada. Reservations are handled via WhatsApp.
